summary: Duwa Lashi La assumed the acting presidential function when the National Unity Government was formed on 16 April 2021. Mahn Winn Khaing Thann continued as head of government, now titled Prime Minister.
authority_status: parallel authority; limited and contested territorial reach
date_basis: The original Federal Democracy Charter, Part II, chapter 3, paragraph 12 automatically assigns presidential duties to the first vice president when the president cannot serve. It is not inferred from the vice-presidential title alone. Mahn’s continuous government headship is counted once from 9 March. date_basis: Order 9/2021 forms SAC on 2 February under section 419, following the separately recorded coup on 1 February.
caveats: This records the establishment or ending of a separately empowered collective authority. It does not count a new personal accession by Min Aung Hlaing, whose continuing rule is already recorded.

summary: First vice-prime minister Baatyrbekov took the acting premiership after Boronov was released from caretaker duties. The government spokesperson confirmed his exercise of the role on 10 October.
date_basis: Boronov was released from acting duties on 9 October; the first-deputy substitution rule and the government spokesperson’s 10 October confirmation identify Baatyrbekov.
caveats: Japarov claimed the premiership from 6 October. Baatyrbekov’s legal authority was still asserted after Japarov began effective government activity; that overlap is preserved in the successor record.

outgoing: Vacant after election conclusion between 5 and 7 August 2020 (last holder Mahinda Rajapaksa)
summary: Rajapaksa resumed the premiership by oath on 9 August after the outgoing cabinet and PM functions ended at the conclusion of the parliamentary election.
date_basis: Required oath after constitutionally mandated cessation at election conclusion.
caveats: The constitutional conclusion occurred between polling on 5 August and the final-result report at 05:51 on 7 August; the exact threshold time is not asserted. This interpretation counts an actual legal vacancy under the protocol; broader political descriptions often treat the same person’s successive terms as continuous. No separate interim PM is established.
